evidence: src/event_object_movement.c:6639-6671 changes GetObjectObjectCollidesWith by excluding collisions whenever either the candidate target or moving source is the reserved remote.
test/coop/presence_runtime.c:763-838 executes GetObjectEventIdByPosition and GetInteractedLinkPlayerScript, but no candidate test calls GetObjectObjectCollidesWith or CheckForObjectEventCollision.
The sealed RPAC3-005 requirement calls for deterministic execution of local-link isolation paths, including preservation of legacy local-link behavior while remotes remain nonblocking.
findings.impact: The focused suite can pass even if the global collision filter later makes an ordinary link-player ObjectEvent ignore a real object or otherwise regresses legacy link/RFU collision behavior.
findings.observation: The corrected local-link regression proves lookup and link-interaction isolation, but it still does not execute the collision function whose source-and-target behavior changed.
findings.recommendation: Extend the focused regression to call GetObjectObjectCollidesWith with a genuine link-player ObjectEvent, a reserved remote, and an ordinary overlapping object; prove only the remote is nonblocking and ordinary link-player-to-real-object collision remains unchanged.
